83: std::string url_decode(std::string_view value) {
84:     std::string decoded;
85:     decoded.reserve(value.size());
86: 
87:     for (size_t i = 0; i < value.size(); ++i) {
88:         if (value[i] == '+') {
89:             decoded.push_back(' ');
90:             continue;
91:         }
92: 
93:         if (value[i] == '%' && i + 2 < value.size()) {
94:             int high = hex_value(value[i + 1]);
95:             int low = hex_value(value[i + 2]);
96:             if (high != -1 && low != -1) {
97:                 decoded.push_back(static_cast<char>(high * 16 + low));
98:                 i += 2;
99:                 continue;
100:             }
101:         }
102: 
103:         decoded.push_back(value[i]);
104:     }
105: 
106:     return decoded;
107: }

109: std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string> parse_form(std::string_view body) {
110:     std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string> fields;
111: 
112:     size_t start = 0;
113:     while (start < body.size()) {
114:         size_t end = body.find('&', start);
115:         if (end == std::string_view::npos) {
116:             end = body.size();
117:         }
118: 
119:         std::string_view part = body.substr(start, end - start);
120:         size_t eq = part.find('=');
121: 
122:         std::string key = url_decode(part.substr(0, eq));
123:         std::string value;
124:         if (eq != std::string_view::npos) {
125:             value = url_decode(part.substr(eq + 1));
126:         }
127: 
128:         if (!key.empty()) {
129:             fields[std::move(key)] = std::move(value);
130:         }
131: 
132:         start = end + 1;
133:     }
134: 
135:     return fields;
136: }

152:         path.erase(query);
